name: contact patch
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 车轮与钢轨实际接触所覆盖的局部区域。
usage_overview: 接触斑用于描述轮轨实际承压的局部范围，是比较接触范围和分析接触应力的对象。局部接触模型可求得其形状及区域内的应力分布。

complete_examples.text: For this model, the contact patch is within the range of [−0.763, −0.743] m and [−0.0061, 0.0062] m respectively for the Y-coordinate of the wheel profile and the longitudinal contact range.

Besides the contact patch is within the range of [0.736, 0.764] m towards the Y –coordinate of the wheel profile for the force equilibrium model, and within the range of [0.735, 0.765] m for this model.
All the parameters of stripes inside the contact patch should contribute to the penetration.
Finally, the contact patch distribute along the trace line can be obtained.
